chunks: Ibn Mahbub, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah عليه السلام saying:
Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled regarding a man whose perineum is struck, so that he can no longer control his stool nor his urine, that in such a case the full diyah is due.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam Ali عليه السلام as the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.ٱلدِّيَةَ: financial compensation for bodily injury or killing

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah ruling if an injury causes a person to lose control of urine and stool?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام concerning severe bodily injury. It establishes that if a blow causes a man to lose control over both defecation and urination, the injury entails the full diyah because of the grave and lasting harm.
